article_title: 从 MCP 服务器发现 Agent Skills：.NET 中的一次发布、随处可用
core_theme: Agent Skills 通过 MCP 服务器集中分发，多个 Agent 按需发现和加载
reader_takeaway: 理解 MCP 技能的工作机制，知道如何把技能从嵌入变为集中分发
summary_angle: 一次发布 → 按需发现 → 无需部署：把技能分发从文件拷贝升级为基础设施

information_blocks.source_anchor: 平台团队把技能发布到 MCP 服务器，skill-md 或 archive 形式
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中心服务器节点向外辐射，技能包从服务器发出

information_blocks.source_anchor: Agent 通过 UseMcpSkills(client) 连接服务器并发现技能
information_blocks.visual_idea: 多个 Agent 节点从同一个 MCP 服务器拉取技能

information_blocks.source_anchor: 更新技能不需要重新部署 Agent，下一次发现自动生效
information_blocks.visual_idea: Agent 和服务器之间的虚线连接，表示动态更新

main_metaphor: 中央枢纽分发站，技能包像标准化模块从中心流向各 Agent 终端
primary_subject: 一个简洁的 MCP 服务器/中枢节点，连接着多个 Agent 终端
subject_action: 服务器居中，技能以模块化包的形式向四周的 Agent 终端分发
composition: 居中主物体 + 少量辅助符号
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: European clear-line comic style, precise outlines, flat readable colors, tidy environments, restrained humor and detail
selected_style_reason: 用户未指定风格，本篇从 40 项风格池随机选中；release 类型适合用清晰线条和干净配色突出中心产品符号
style_safety_note: 清单风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或艺术家复刻
draft_goal: 验证主题（中心服务器向多 Agent 分发技能）和叙事信息块是否清晰可读
revision_targets: 如果主体不够突出，加强中心枢纽的视觉权重
如果信息块标签太多或太密，减少到 2 个
如果风格偏赛博朋克，收紧色彩控制回到欧漫清线风
final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: Agent Skills distributed from a central MCP server to multiple agents — publish once, discover everywhere. The reader should quickly feel this is about centralized skill distribution infrastructure for AI agents.

Summary angle: Publish once → Discover on demand → No redeploy. Turn skill distribution from file-copying into infrastructure.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- mechanism: A central server hub emitting skill packages outward, labeled 「发布技能」
- mechanism: Multiple agent nodes pulling skills from the same MCP server, labeled 「按需发现」
- takeaway: Dynamic dotted connections between agents and server indicating updates flow without redeploy, labeled 「无需部署」

Main metaphor: A central distribution hub where standardized skill modules flow from the center to surrounding agent terminals.
Subject: A clean MCP server/hub node at center, connecting to multiple agent terminal nodes around it, with skill packages flowing outward.
Composition/framing: Centered main subject with supporting symbolic elements. Prefer horizontal or radial storytelling that stays legible in a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine product-poster style illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: European clear-line comic style, precise outlines, flat readable colors, tidy environments, restrained humor and detail. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: deep blue (#1a3a5c), white/light gray background, warm orange accent (#e8870a).
Visible text policy: allow only 2-3 short Chinese labels from the information blocks: 「发布技能」「按需发现」「无需部署」. Each label <= 4 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: floating chips, code rain, neon buildings, generic robot stances, cyberpunk purple-blue light pollution, HUD overlays, fake terminals, fake dashboards.
